question: Why did Los Angeles pour 96 million black balls onto its drinking water?
answer: News reports in 2015 said the balls were there to stop evaporation during the drought. The black balls actually shade the water so a carcinogen, bromate, can't form. Saving water came second.
move: The balls shade the water so a carcinogen can’t form. Saving water came second.
